Titre du poste: Ingénieur en intelligence artificielle (IA) Description du poste Nous sommes à la recherche d'un(e) ingénieur(e) en intelligence artificielle hautement qualifié(e) pour concevoir et développer des applications alimentées par l'IA de calibre production au sein d'un environnement d'entreprise à grande échelle. Ce rôle soutient des initiatives au sein de l'une des plus importantes organisations d'assurance aux États-Unis, visant à transformer l'expérience des membres grâce à l'intelligence artificielle. L'équipe développe actuellement un assistant basé sur l'IA pour soutenir le traitement des réclamations, ainsi qu'une plateforme intégrée à 360° permettant de créer des profils de santé complets pour les utilisateurs. Ces solutions s'appuient sur des capacités avancées de grands modèles de langage (LLM) et sont soutenues par une vaste plateforme de découverte et d'exploitation des données. Responsabilités Contribuer à la conception et à la mise en uvre de solutions d'IA agentique, notamment pour des cas d'utilisation tels que les jumeaux numériques et les systèmes intelligents destinés aux membres. Concevoir et développer des flux de travail LLM agentiques ou multiétapes de niveau production, incluant la logique d'orchestration et la coordination entre plusieurs composantes d'IA ou services backend. Définir l'architecture système à partir de zéro. Concevoir, développer et intégrer des API RESTful tout en contribuant au développement frontend et backend. Maintenir des pratiques d'ingénierie de niveau production en matière de conteneurisation, de tests, de performance, d'évolutivité et de fiabilité à l'aide de Docker. Participer à des discussions orientées solutions avec les parties prenantes. Compétences essentielles Expérience avec les architectures sans serveur (Serverless) sur AWS et le développement de systèmes de production utilisant AWS Lambda, Amazon Bedrock, API Gateway et DynamoDB. Expertise en Infrastructure as Code (IaC) avec CloudFormation ou Terraform. Expérience en développement full stack et en conception d'API. Maîtrise des pratiques d'ingénierie de niveau production. Solides compétences en communication et expérience auprès des clients ou des parties prenantes. Compétences et qualifications supplémentaires Expérience dans un environnement réglementé par la HIPAA. Bonne connaissance ou expérience significative de développement en Python. Expérience dans les secteurs de la santé ou du gouvernement. Environnement de travail Le travail à distance est possible partout au Canada ou aux États-Unis, à l'exception du Québec. L'environnement est fortement axé sur AWS et offre une exposition à des implémentations de pointe en IA agentique et en grands modèles de langage (LLM). Les ingénieurs auront l'occasion de contribuer à des initiatives d'IA à fort impact à l'échelle de l'entreprise et pourront également participer à d'autres projets après leur engagement initial. Job Summary This role focuses on designing and optimizing robust data platforms using Apache Iceberg for a hi tech environment ensuring reliable data ingestion storage and access for analytics teams. The professional will work from office in a day shift collaborating with product and engineering partners to deliver scalable data solutions that improve decision making and support innovative digital services for global stakeholders. Responsibilities Design and implement highly scalable data lake and warehouse solutions using Apache Iceberg to support complex analytics and reporting needs in a hi tech product ecosystem. Develop efficient batch and streaming data pipelines that ensure accurate ingestion transformation and partitioning of large data volumes while maintaining strong data quality standards. Optimize data storage layouts file formats and metadata management within Apache Iceberg environments to achieve improved query performance and resource utilization. Collaborate closely with product managers data analysts and software engineers to translate business requirements into well structured data models and reliable data services. Establish robust data governance practices including schema evolution strategies data retention rules and catalog management to maintain consistent and compliant datasets. Implement monitoring and alerting for data workflows by configuring metrics logs and health checks that proactively identify data integrity or performance issues. Create clear technical documentation covering data architecture diagrams pipeline specifications and operational procedures to support knowledge sharing and smooth onboarding. Support performance tuning activities by analyzing query patterns optimizing joins and aggregations and refining clustering strategies within the data platform. Coordinate with security and compliance teams to embed access controls encryption mechanisms and audit trails that protect sensitive information in line with hi tech industry expectations. Provide guidance to stakeholders on using curated datasets and semantic layers effectively so that analytics outcomes directly contribute to product innovation and customer experience improvements. Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by evaluating emerging data technologies compatible with Apache Iceberg and proposing practical enhancements to the existing stack. Engage in cross functional discussions to ensure data solutions align with organizational objectives and create positive impact on digital services offered to society. Participate in on site collaboration sessions during regular day shifts to resolve data issues quickly and maintain high availability of critical analytical datasets. Qualifications Bring strong hands on experience working with Apache Iceberg in production environments including design of tables partitions and snapshot management for reliable data storage. Demonstrate solid knowledge of data engineering concepts such as ETL development

We are seeking a data-driven Business Analyst to design and optimize customer support, teleoperations, and remote assistance workflows for our autonomous taxi (robotaxi) fleet. In this role, you will act as the bridge between autonomous vehicle operations and rider support. While you will not be performing raw point-cloud or sensor signal processing, you must bring a solid conceptual understanding of the autonomous stack—including ADAS, LiDAR, radar, and camera perception—to accurately translate vehicle events into real-time agent workflows. You will pair this domain literacy with strong SQL, Python, and modern dashboarding skills, alongside hands-on application of GenAI and GenBI, to automate customer interactions and drive fleet performance insights. Please note that this role is fully onsite in Plano, TX . Translate vehicle health, perception status flags (LiDAR/radar/camera health indicators), and ADAS state transitions into clear operational triggers for the support team. Define and track mission-critical metrics: Time-to-Intervene (TTI), Mean Time to Resolve (MTTR), First Contact Resolution (FCR), and Rider Safety NPS. Data Analytics, SQL & Dashboard Engineering: Write complex SQL queries across relational databases and cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, or Redshift) to track intervention trends, fleet exceptions, and call center throughput. Use Python (Pandas, NumPy) for exploratory data analysis, pattern identification in incident data, and automated reporting scripts. Design, build, and maintain production-grade operational dashboards using Power BI, Tableau, or QuickSight to deliver real-time operational visibility to executive and operations teams. GenAI & GenBI Implementation: Specify functional requirements for contact center GenAI tools: real-time call summarization, automated agent response recommendations, and context-aware action triggers. Support the rollout of GenBI tools (e.g., Power BI Copilot, ThoughtSpot, Amazon Q) to enable operations stakeholders to query fleet and support data using natural language. Collaborate with AI engineers to design safety guardrails, prompt templates, and evaluation criteria for customer-facing conversational agents inside the vehicle. Agile Delivery & Product Backlog: Author detailed PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and process flow diagrams (BPMN) in Jira and Confluence. Partner with Teleoperations Leads, Fleet Operations, Data Engineers, and CCaaS engineering teams to deliver iterative platform upgrades. While you will not be performing raw point-cloud or sensor signal processing, you must bring a solid conceptual understanding of the autonomous stack—including ADAS, LiDAR, radar, and camera perception—to accurately translate vehicle events into real-time agent workflows. You will pair this domain literacy with strong SQL, Python, and modern dashboarding skills, alongside hands-on application of GenAI and GenBI, to automate customer interactions and drive fleet performance insights. Please note that this role is fully onsite in Plano, TX . Role Responsibilities Autonomous Fleet & Teleoperations Workflows: Define functional requirements for contact center agents and remote-guidance operators handling robotaxi edge cases (e.g., sensor-degradation alerts, pick-up/drop-off deadlocks, unexpected stops). Translate vehicle health, perception status flags (LiDAR/radar/camera health indicators), and ADAS state transitions into clear operational triggers for the support team. Define and track mission-critical metrics: Time-to-Intervene (TTI), Mean Time to Resolve (MTTR), First Contact Resolution (FCR), and Rider Safety NPS. Data Analytics, SQL & Dashboard Engineering: Write complex SQL queries across relational databases and cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, or Redshift) to track intervention trends, fleet exceptions, and call center throughput. Use Python (Pandas, NumPy) for exploratory data analysis, pattern identification in incident data, and automated reporting scripts. Design, build, and maintain production-grade operational dashboards using Power BI, Tableau, or QuickSight to deliver real-time operational visibility to executive and operations teams. GenAI & GenBI Implementation: Specify functional requirements for contact center GenAI tools: real-time call summarization, automated agent response recommendations, and context-aware action triggers. Support the rollout of GenBI tools (e.g., Power BI Copilot, ThoughtSpot, Amazon Q) to enable operations stakeholders to query fleet and support data using natural language. Collaborate with AI engineers to design safety guardrails, prompt templates, and evaluation criteria for customer-facing conversational agents inside the vehicle. Agile Delivery & Product Backlog: Author detailed PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and process flow diagrams (BPMN) in Jira and Confluence. Partner with Teleoperations Leads, Fleet Operations, Data Engineers, and CCaaS engineering teams to deliver iterative platform upgrades. Desired Skills & Experience Domain Knowledge : We would prefer someone with 3+ years in the Aut

job_title: Data Engineer – Snowflake / Apache Iceberg / Python
description: Job Responsibilities Design, develop, and implement scalable data engineering solutions to support PIPL program requirements. Build and maintain end-to-end ETL/ELT pipelines using Python, SQL, and modern data engineering frameworks. Develop and manage data lakehouse architectures using Apache Iceberg and Snowflake. Create and support a dedicated China data environment on Alibaba Cloud (AliCloud) for data processing, analytics, machine learning, and reporting workloads. Automate data ingestion, transformation, validation, and reporting processes to improve operational efficiency. Optimize data pipelines, storage, and query performance to ensure scalability and reliability. Collaborate with architects, program leads, and business stakeholders to gather requirements and deliver data solutions. Ensure data quality, governance, security, and compliance with PIPL and enterprise standards. Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve data platform and pipeline issues. Contribute to best practices in DataOps, CI/CD, automation, and cloud-native data engineering. Job Requirements 5+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Warehousing, or Big Data environments. Strong hands-on experience with Apache Iceberg. Proven experience working with Snowflake for data warehousing and analytics. Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL development. Experience designing and building ETL/ELT pipelines and data integration solutions. Solid understanding of data lake, lakehouse, and data warehouse architectures. Experience working with cloud platforms, preferably Alibaba Cloud (AliCloud). Knowledge of distributed data processing technologies such as Apache Spark, Flink, or similar frameworks. Experience with data modeling, performance tuning, and data quality management. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, Git, and automation tools. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills. Experience in regulatory or data privacy-focused environments (PIPL/GDPR) is an added advantage. #LI-CTSAPAC

job_title: Data Quality Engineer - Remote in Canada
location: Halifax,NS-6940 Mumford Rd, Nova Scotia, Canada
description: Data Quality Engineer As a Data Quality Engineer specializing in Tricentis Tosca Data Integrity at Cognizant, you will design and execute automated data validation across extract, transform, and load (ETL) processes, data warehouses, and data migrations. You will work with development and data engineering teams to verify data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and transformation rules across source and target systems. This is a full-time, remote role open only to candidates located in Canada. In this role, you will Review business requirements, source-to-target mappings, and ETL designs to identify test scenarios and prepare test plans and cases. Design and execute ETL, data warehouse, and data migration tests, including automated data validation scripts using Tosca Data Integrity. Validate data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and transformation rules across source systems, staging layers, and target databases. Perform source-to-target reconciliation and data integrity checks, using SQL queries to validate transformations and load processes. Log, track, and retest defects in partnership with development and data engineering teams. Collaborate with onshore and offshore teams to deliver testing activities and prepare test execution reports and knowledge-transfer documentation. Provide regular status updates, identify risks, and support production validation activities. What you need to have to be considered 6+ years of overall experience in software testing, ETL testing, and data validation, including 3+ years of hands-on experience with Tricentis Tosca Data Integrity. Strong experience in ETL, data warehouse, and data migration testing, including validation across source systems, staging layers, and target databases. Hands-on SQL query writing and database testing experience with relational databases such as SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL, or DB2. Strong understanding of ETL processes, data transformations, source-to-target mapping, data reconciliation, and data integrity testing. Ability to analyze business requirements, data models, mapping documents, and technical specifications and translate them into test plans and test cases. Experience with test execution and defect management using tools such as JIRA, Azure DevOps, or ALM. Experience in Agile/Scrum environments and an onshore-offshore delivery model, with effective cross-functional collaboration. Strong analytical, root-cause analysis, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills, with clear verbal and written communication. These will help you stand out Insurance domain experience. description: Turkish Digital Marketing Campaign Analyst (Paid Media & Video Streaming) Join a dynamic team supporting global advertisers in the planning, execution, optimization, and reporting of high-impact digital advertising campaigns. As a Digital Marketing Campaign Analyst, you will work closely with Account Managers and Campaign Managers to drive campaign performance across video streaming platform advertising, demand generation, paid search, display and creator partnership initiatives. You will be responsible for monitoring campaign performance, optimizing targeting and bidding strategies, analyzing data-driven insights, ensuring brand safety compliance, and delivering actionable recommendations that help clients achieve their business objectives and growth targets. The role also includes supporting creator partnerships, evaluating content for compliance, identifying growth opportunities, and producing performance reports that demonstrate campaign success. Key Responsibilities Optimize and manage video streaming platform campaigns, creator profiles on video platforms, paid search, display and Demand Gen campaigns. Conduct creator content reviews, brand safety checks, and compliance assessments. Monitor budgets, pacing, and KPI performance to maximize campaign results. Analyze campaign data and provide strategic recommendations to improve performance. Support campaign setup, keyword management, targeting strategies, and ad operations. Generate performance reports and deliver actionable insights to stakeholders. Collaborate with global teams to identify growth opportunities and drive client success. Stay current with industry trends, advertising technologies, and AI-driven marketing tools. Requirements 1.5years of experience in digital marketing, paid media, SEM/PPC, Google Ads, display advertising, video advertising, account management, or customer-facing campaign support. Strong understanding of online advertising channels, campaign optimization, and performance marketing metrics. Hands-on experience with Google Ads and video streaming platform advertising. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including Pivot Tables and complex formulas. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder communication abilities. Experience working with international clients and cross-functional global teams. Fluent English and Turkish communication skills, both written and verbal. Offer: Pleasant and inspiring working atmosphere; Opportunity to be part of a rapidly expanding global organization; Office facilities in a convenient location in Lisbon; Training & development opportunities; Relocation allowance & relocation support (For candidates moving from abroad).
